Privacy Policy

Effective October 3, 2026

Previous version effective January 1, 2025

TroTro (“we,” “our,” or “us”) is committed to protecting the privacy of every family that uses our platform. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using TroTro you agree to the practices described below.

This policy covers the TroTro mobile app for parents and drivers and this website. In the app you may also see the shorter TroTro Privacy Summary; this policy is the fuller version of the same practices.

Contents

  1. 1. Information We Collect
  2. 2. How We Use Your Information
  3. 3. How We Share Your Information
  4. 4. Children’s Privacy
  5. 5. Location Data
  6. 6. Data Retention

  8. 8. Your Rights
  9. 9. Security

  12. 12. Contact Us
  13. 13. Changes to This Policy

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly and information generated as you use the app.

Account information

  • Parent full name, email address, and phone number, your password (stored in hashed form), and an optional profile photo
  • Student name, grade level, and school name
  • Pickup and drop-off address
  • Emergency contact name, relationship, and phone number
  • Any needs you choose to share so we can transport your child safely, and the adults you authorize to receive your child

Driver information

  • For drivers: identity, license, driving-record, background-check, vehicle, and insurance details, and the documents submitted to verify them

Location data

  • Driver precise GPS location while a route is active, including while the driver app is in the background (shared in real time with the parents of the children on that ride)
  • Pickup and drop-off coordinates derived from your registered address
  • Ride records: when and where each child was picked up and dropped off

Payment information

  • Payments are processed by Stripe. We do not store full card numbers; we keep only a card summary (such as card brand, last four digits, and expiry date) and Stripe reference numbers

Usage and device data

  • Records of activity in the service, such as ride events, ride reports, and account changes, and the technical logs our servers keep to operate and secure the service
  • A push-notification token for your device and its platform (iOS or Android)

Support communications

  • Messages you send to us for support

Website inquiries

  • If you use the contact forms on this website, the details you enter — such as your name, email, phone number, school or organization, neighborhood, and message. The website does not ask for a child’s name, date of birth, home address, or school records

2. How We Use Your Information

  • Providing and operating the TroTro service, including real-time ride tracking and notifications
  • Matching students with assigned drivers and communicating route details
  • Sending pickup, drop-off, delay, and emergency alerts to registered parents
  • Verifying driver identity and maintaining driver safety records
  • Investigating reports and resolving disputes between parents and drivers
  • Processing payments and managing your plan
  • Operating, securing, and improving the service
  • Complying with applicable laws and responding to lawful requests

3. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only in the following limited circumstances.

With drivers

Assigned drivers receive what they need for the route: the student’s name and grade, the pickup and drop-off locations, and the school. Your name and phone number — and those of any adult you authorize to receive your child — are shared only while the ride is in progress and solely for the purpose of route coordination.

With co-parents you invite

The parent who adds a child to TroTro can invite another parent or guardian with a one-time code. A co-parent can see that child’s rides, live trip status, ride history, and pickup address, receive notifications, and file a ride report; they cannot change the child’s service or invite anyone else. The inviting parent can see who has access and remove a co-parent’s access at any time in the app.

With school partners

Schools that have a logistics partnership with TroTro may receive scheduled pickup and drop-off times and student attendance confirmations. No financial or health information is shared.

With service providers

We work with third parties who process data on our behalf, only as needed to provide their service to TroTro: cloud hosting and database providers (Vercel and Neon), payment processing (Stripe), push notifications (Expo), transactional email (Resend), maps, address lookup and geocoding (Google Maps Platform), and, for drivers, verification providers that perform identity, driving-record, and background checks.

For legal reasons

We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or government authority, or to protect the safety of any person.

No advertising or tracking

We do not use third-party advertising, and we do not track you across other companies’ apps or websites. The TroTro app does not include an analytics SDK. If we add product analytics, we will update this policy first. This website uses Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights to measure visits and page performance; the events we record describe which page element was used, never the content of a form.

4. Children’s Privacy

TroTro is designed for parents and guardians to manage transportation for minors. We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children under 13. All student information is entered and managed by the parent or guardian who holds the account — children do not have TroTro accounts. If you believe a child has provided us information without parental consent, contact us and we will delete it promptly.

Student data is used solely to facilitate safe transportation. It is never used for advertising, sold to third parties, or shared beyond what is necessary to operate the service. Parents can ask us to access, correct, or delete their child’s information using the contact details in Section 12.

5. Location Data

Driver location is collected only while a route is active — including when the driver app is in the background, so arrivals are still detected if the driver switches to a navigation app — and is shared in real time with the parents of the children on that ride. We use it to show the vehicle approaching, send pickup and drop-off alerts, and confirm arrival at each stop. Location collection stops when the route ends.

When you enter a pickup or drop-off address, we convert it to map coordinates using a mapping provider. The location points and pickup and drop-off record of each ride are kept as part of that ride’s safety record (see Data Retention).

We do not collect location from children or their devices. We do not collect parent device location unless you explicitly grant permission for a future feature.

6. Data Retention

  • Active account data is retained for as long as your account remains open
  • We keep information for as long as needed to provide the service, support safety and audit needs, and meet legal and operational obligations
  • Certain records — such as agreement acceptances, ride and custody records (who drove, when, and where each child was picked up and released), billing and payment records, and records of the service emails we sent — are retained for safety, audit, and financial purposes and are not deleted while they are required

7. Deleting Your Account

Parents can delete their account in the app: Profile → Account → Delete account. You confirm with your password, and deletion takes effect immediately.

What deletion removes

  • Your login is closed and you are signed out
  • Your name, phone number, email address, profile photo, and home address are removed from your profile
  • Your children’s names are removed from our records
  • Your emergency contacts, saved pickup locations, and notification preferences are deleted
  • Any co-parent access to your children ends, and unused invitation codes are cancelled

What we keep

  • The record of past rides — who drove, when, and where each child was collected and released — as a safety record, with your family’s names removed from it
  • Billing and payment records needed for financial and legal obligations
  • A record that the account was deleted

If your child is on a ride, deletion waits until the ride is complete.

Requesting deletion by email

Drivers, and anyone who cannot use the in-app option, can request deletion of their account and associated data by emailing trotrotransit@gmail.com from the email address on the account, with the subject “Delete my account”. We may need to confirm your identity first, and we will respond within 30 days.

8. Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:

  • Access a copy of the personal data we hold about you
  • Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
  • Request deletion of your account and associated data
  • Object to or restrict certain types of processing
  • Receive your data in a portable format

You can update your account and contact information in the app. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details in Section 12; we may need to confirm your identity first. We will respond within 30 days.

9. Security

We use safeguards including encrypted data transmission (TLS), hashed passwords, and access controls that limit each parent and driver to the information their role requires. Card details are held by our payment processor, not by TroTro. No system is completely secure; if you suspect unauthorized access to your account, contact us immediately.

10. Notifications and Emails

We send push notifications through Expo’s push notification service about pickups, drop-offs, delays, emergencies, and your account. You can choose which ride notifications you receive in the app, and turn notifications off in your device settings. We send service emails — such as route, account, and billing notices — through Resend, and we keep a log of those emails (recipient, subject, and delivery status) to confirm delivery and answer questions.

11. Third-Party Links and Services

The app may link to third-party services (e.g. mapping providers). This policy does not apply to those services and we encourage you to review their privacy practices independently.

12. Contact Us

If you have questions or concerns about this policy or how your data is handled, please reach out:

  • Email: trotrotransit@gmail.com
  • Contact form: jointrotro.com/contact
  • In the TroTro app: Profile → Account → Help & Support

13. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. When we make material changes we will notify you via in-app alert or email at least 14 days before the change takes effect. Continued use of TroTro after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

1. Overview of TroTro Transportation

TroTro is a transportation platform that connects families with vetted drivers to safely transport children to and from school and other approved destinations. TroTro arranges, coordinates, and monitors these rides. We are currently operating a controlled pilot, and these Terms reflect that stage of the service.

2. Service Description

TroTro provides:

  • Scheduled transportation for your child between approved pickup and drop-off locations.
  • Vetted, verified drivers who meet TroTro’s safety standards.
  • Live trip tracking and pickup and drop-off notifications during active rides.
  • Customer support before, during, and after rides.

TroTro coordinates transportation; drivers operate their own vehicles. TroTro is not a school, a childcare provider, or a common carrier.

3. Parent Responsibilities

You agree to:

  • Provide accurate and current information about your child, your contact details, and pickup and drop-off locations.
  • Keep your account, schedule, and emergency contacts up to date.
  • Ensure your child is ready at the scheduled pickup time and location.
  • Inform TroTro of any medical, behavioral, or accessibility needs relevant to safe transportation.
  • Communicate schedule changes and absences as early as possible.

You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide. TroTro relies on it to deliver the service safely.

4. Pickup and Drop-off Expectations

  • Your child should be ready and waiting at the agreed pickup location at the scheduled time.
  • Drivers will wait a reasonable, limited time at pickup (see Late Pickup Policy below).
  • At drop-off, your child will be released only to an authorized location or an authorized person as you have designated.
  • For younger children or where you have requested it, drop-off requires an authorized adult to receive the child. If no authorized person is available, TroTro will follow the emergency procedures in Section 21.

5. Authorized Pickup and Drop-off Requirements

  • You must designate who is authorized to receive your child at drop-off.
  • TroTro and its drivers may request identification to confirm an authorized person before releasing a child.
  • If an unauthorized person attempts to receive your child, the driver will not release the child and will contact you and TroTro support.
  • You are responsible for keeping your list of authorized persons current.

6. Scheduling

  • Rides are arranged according to the schedule associated with your account and plan.
  • Recurring schedules (for example, weekday school transportation) continue until changed or cancelled.
  • One-time or changed rides are subject to driver availability, especially during the pilot.
  • Schedule changes should be requested through the app or support with as much notice as possible.

7. Late Pickup Policy

  • Drivers will wait a reasonable, limited period at the pickup location (typically a few minutes) to keep the route on time for other families.
  • If your child is not present within that window, the driver may need to continue the route, and the ride may be recorded as a missed pickup.
  • Repeated late or missed pickups may affect scheduling. Please contact support promptly if your child will be late or absent.

8. Service Interruptions

Transportation may occasionally be delayed, rescheduled, or unavailable due to circumstances including traffic, mechanical issues, driver availability, weather, road conditions, or events beyond our reasonable control. We will make reasonable efforts to notify you and to arrange alternatives where possible. During the pilot, service availability may be more limited than at full launch.

9. School Closures

  • TroTro follows the regular schedule based on the information associated with your account.
  • On days a school is closed (holidays, planned closures, or unplanned closures), scheduled school transportation for that school will generally not run.
  • You are responsible for informing TroTro of closures, early dismissals, or schedule changes that are specific to your child or school and that TroTro may not otherwise know about.

10. Weather Delays

In the event of severe weather or unsafe road conditions, TroTro may delay, modify, or suspend service to protect the safety of children and drivers. We will make reasonable efforts to notify affected families. Safety always takes priority over schedule.

11. Driver Substitution

The driver assigned to your child may change from time to time due to scheduling, availability, illness, or operational needs. Any substitute driver is a TroTro-vetted, verified driver who meets the same safety standards. You can review your current driver’s verification status in the Trust Center at any time.

12. Vehicle Substitution

The vehicle used for your child’s ride may change when a driver uses an approved backup or replacement vehicle. Any substitute vehicle must meet TroTro’s vehicle standards, including registration, insurance, and safe operating condition.

13. Communication Expectations

  • TroTro communicates with you through the app, push notifications, email, SMS, and/or phone.
  • You agree to receive operational communications related to your child’s transportation (such as pickup, drop-off, delay, and safety messages).
  • You agree to keep your contact information accurate so we can reach you, including in an emergency.
  • You agree to communicate respectfully with drivers, support staff, and other users.

14. Billing Overview

  • Fees for the plan you select are billed through our third-party payment processor.
  • By providing a payment method, you authorize TroTro to charge it for the rides and subscription you arrange, plus any applicable taxes and fees.
  • The transportation service relationship is established by these Terms; payment authorization is a separate consent to be charged and does not replace these Terms.

15. Subscription Overview

  • Many TroTro plans are offered on a recurring subscription basis (for example, monthly).
  • Your subscription renews automatically each billing period until cancelled.
  • Plan features, pricing, and availability may change; we will provide notice of material changes as required.

16. Cancellation Policy

  • You may cancel your subscription at any time through the app or by contacting support.
  • Cancellation generally takes effect at the end of the current billing period, after which recurring transportation and billing stop.
  • Cancelling a subscription cancels future scheduled rides associated with it.

17. Refund Policy

  • Subscription fees are generally billed in advance for the upcoming period and are non-refundable except where required by law or expressly stated.
  • If TroTro fails to provide a scheduled ride due to our error, contact support; we may, at our discretion, provide a credit or adjustment.
  • Refund and credit decisions outside of legal requirements are made at TroTro’s reasonable discretion during the pilot.

18. Safety Expectations

  • Every TroTro driver passes identity, driving-record, background, vehicle, and safety checks before carrying a child, and is monitored on an ongoing basis.
  • Children are expected to wear seat belts and use appropriate safety restraints as required by law and TroTro policy.
  • You are responsible for providing any legally required child safety or booster seat needs information so TroTro can accommodate them.

19. Behavior Expectations

  • Children and adults using the service are expected to behave safely and respectfully toward drivers and others.
  • Unsafe behavior that endangers a driver, a child, or others may result in the ride being ended, service being suspended, or the account being terminated.
  • You are responsible for your child’s conduct during transportation to the extent reasonably within your control.

20. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law:

  • TroTro provides the service on an “as is” and “as available” basis during the pilot.
  • TroTro is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages.
  • TroTro’s total liability arising out of or relating to the service is limited to the amount you paid to TroTro for the service in the period giving rise to the claim.
  • Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law, including liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence where the law does not permit its exclusion.

21. Emergency Procedures

  • In a medical or safety emergency, the driver’s first priority is the safety of the child, and the driver may contact emergency services (such as 911) as appropriate.
  • TroTro will make reasonable efforts to contact you and your designated emergency contacts promptly.
  • If an authorized person is not available to receive your child at drop-off, TroTro will attempt to reach you and your emergency contacts and will keep your child safe with the driver or staff until the situation is resolved.
  • Please keep your emergency contact information accurate and current at all times.

22. Privacy Summary

TroTro collects and uses information needed to provide transportation safely, including your account and contact details, your child’s information, trip and location data during active rides, and payment information processed by our payment provider. We use this information to operate, secure, and improve the service, and we share it only as needed to provide the service or as required by law. For more detail, see the TroTro Privacy Policy at jointrotro.com/privacy and the TroTro Privacy Summary available in the app.

23. Modification of Terms

  • TroTro may update these Terms from time to time.
  • When we publish a new version, we will ask you to review and accept it before you continue arranging rides. The version you accepted, and when you accepted it, are recorded for audit.
  • Previous versions remain available so there is always a clear record of what you agreed to.

24. Contact Information

Questions about the service or these Terms?

  • Email: trotrotransit@gmail.com
  • Contact form: jointrotro.com/contact
  • In the TroTro app: Profile → Account → Help & Support

By accepting, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Transportation Terms of Service.
